product_metadata.title: Alarm Clock, Large Display Digital Clock with 2 Alarms and Easy to Use, 6-Level Dimmer, 3-Level Alarm Sound & 3 Ringtones Bedside Alarm Clock for Bedrooms, 12/24H, 9 MINS Snooze, Adapter Isn't Include
features: EASY TO READ - This alarm clock for bedrooms have a 5'' clear large screen, which makes it easy to catch time with a glance, even if you aren't very awake or don't wear glasses.

COZY BRIGHTNESS - The brightness of the bedside alarm clock can be adjusted and turned off completely. Also, the lighting is very soft and friendly to the eye. Great for people with tired eyes after studying or work.
EASY TO USE - There aren't too many complicated functions of this digital clock. And the buttons equip with icons and words, allowing you to set time and alarm without stress.
DUAL ALARMS - This digital alarm clock allows you to set 2 independent alarms, suitable for couples or families. This is a perfect option if you and your husband need to get up at different times.

IDEAL ALARM - The volume of this alarm clock can be adjusted per need to wake you up. Also, it has 3 ringtones (birdsong/chord ringtone/buzzer), which are suitable for those who prefer different alarm sounds.
STYLISH DESIGN - This digital clock has a unique curved screen design, making it looks more modern. It is easy to integrate into various furniture. Not only a desk clock but also decorations.
